> I have FastRWeb running on Ubuntu/ Apache2.

> the plot window is empty.
>  
> Any suggestion what might be going wrong?

> the Rserve process is owned by process UID 1000.
> the FastRWeb folder, the tmp folder owner is set to www-data. permissions are all drwxrwxr-x.

The tmp folder needs to be owned by the user that runs Rserve, not by www-data -- or at least that user needs write-permissions.

Simon

messages.subject: Re: FastRWeb - cant display graphic images
messages.body_plain:
Hi Simon:
thanks for the pointer, finally got it to work.
 
I made 2 changes:
1. I notices the working directory of Rserve needs to be set to the tmp directory of FastRWeb. In the R session, I did :
>setwd ("/var/FastRWeb/tmp").
2. I had to set up access control to make sure new files added into the directory inherited the permissions (rwx) of the folder. I achieved this at ubuntu terminal promt via:
$setfacl -Rm g:username:rwX,d:g:username:rwX tmp/

regards 
Nilesh N. Shah
